newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE airports swamped by illegal aliens seeking to benefit from a two-months amnesty period.
- Abu Dhabi's foreign trade at nine billion dirhams in first half of 1996.
- Dubai resumes sugar exports to Iraqi markets.
- Implementation of unified Gulf Cooperation Council tarrifs is expected in 1998.
- Expat babies born outside UAE need visas for entry.
